channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Strock reveals: 'Netanyahu considered permitting prayer inside Gaza - then said no'
item.description: '20 rabbis asked Netanyahu to hold prayer inside Gaza. We are returning to the parts of the Land that we abandoned. We did it in northern Samaria, and we will do it in Gaza as well,' says Minister Orit Strock.

item.title: Ki Teitzei: Drafting Yeshiva students
item.description: My father, the Rav HaNazir, and Rav Tzvi Yehudah were of the opinion that everyone is obligated to go out and fight. This was a milhemet mitzvah, a compulsory war, in which all are expected to participate.

item.title: Netanyahu’s Office: 'Erdogan is an antisemitic dictator who oppresses his own people'
item.description: The Prime Minister’s Office responded to Turkey’s request to issue a “Red Notice" against Netanyahu “for genocide," stating: “Israel has long since ceased to be impressed by Turkey’s hypocrisy. Erdogan is an antisemitic dictator who massacred Kurds, supports the massacre carried out by the Hamas terrorist organization, and oppresses his own people."

item.title: England's outrageous outrage
item.description: What is chutzpah? A Jew pouring a foundation in his ancestral homeland who gets a summons, a sanctions package, a joint communiqué with six other governments and a threat to label his tomatoes. Opinion.

item.title: IDF: Terrorist who crossed yellow line in southern Gaza and approached troops neutralized
item.description:
An individual who, according to the IDF, crossed the yellow line in southern Gaza and approached Israeli troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat was neutralized by soldiers from the Givati Brigade.
The IDF said Southern Command forces remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue operating to eliminate any immediate threats.

item.title: Don’t be like an Ammonite or a Moabite:
item.description: What was wrong with the Moabites and the Ammonites?

item.title: Haredi draft evaders: Yeshiva student arrested and handed over to Military Police
item.description: Escalation in draft battle: Yeshiva student arrested, clashes erupt at Maccabim checkpoint.

item.title: Fear in Sweden: Sword-wielding attacker strikes at school
item.description:
Several people were injured in an attack at a school in Sweden by a man armed with a sword, according to local media reports.
Further details about the circumstances of the incident have not yet been released.

item.title: Escalation as Turkey seeks Interpol arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Israeli officials
item.description: Ankara asks Interpol to issue arrest warrants for Netanyahu and dozens of senior Israeli officials over their alleged involvement in stopping the Global Sumud flotilla en route to Gaza.

item.title: Israel Airports Authority: 100,000 passengers passing through airport today
item.description:
The Israel Airports Authority announced that operations at Ben Gurion Airport have stabilized and returned to normal. The flight schedule is operating as usual, and terminal operations are taking place without delays.
Luggage that had not been sent abroad has been sorted and transferred to the airlines, while baggage belonging to passengers who landed but did not receive it is being delivered to them by the airlines.

item.title: After attack over blowing shofar: Show of support for restaurant in Savyon
item.description: Following an incident in which the owner of the Taurus Smokehouse in Savyon was attacked over blowing a shofar, activists from the Noam Yisrael party came to show their support.

item.title: Authorities expose drone smuggling network, arrssting suspects
item.description: Lahav 433, Tax Authority, uncover drone import network allegedly used for weapons and drug smuggling.

item.title: Vandals tear down Israeli flags - activists return with 50 more
item.description: Days after Israeli flags were vandalized near Rawabi, activists restore them and add dozens more: 'For every flag that was vandalized, we put up another.'

item.title: The answer to destruction
item.description: Isaiah’s message was one of consolation, but also of responsibility.

item.title: A nation of one
item.description: We are not just a united nation. We are a nation of one, so interconnected that we are like a single person. A look at the parasha's topics shows it.

item.title: Unidentified donors are flying Israeli voters home to vote
item.description: Is this a bad or a good thing? And who is behind the initiative? Some are against the idea of flying in to vote and leaving again, some are afraid there is only one type of voter being helped to fly in to vote.

item.title: Bennett warns: Half a million illegal guns are a 'ticking time bomb'
item.description: Former Prime Minister calls illegal weapons a top-level security threat and proposes deploying the Shin Bet to locate and seize them.

item.title: Jewish hikers attacked after mistakenly entering Arab village
item.description: Dozens of Arab rioters hurl rocks at Jewish hikers who apparently entered village by mistake; security forces rush to rescue the group.

item.title: Yair Golan: Jewish-Arab partnership 'frightens them'
item.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan defends party's 'massive campaign' targeting Arab voters, vowing Jews and Arabs will work together to replace government.

item.title: Report: Jews attacked in Gush Etzion, IDF called to the scene
item.description:
A group of Jews touring in eastern Gush Etzion entered an Arab village a short time ago, and was attacked with rocks.
IDF forces were called to the scene to extract the hikers.

item.title: Joint Arab List leaders enlisted Europe against Israel
item.description: Joint Arab List leaders meet European Union ambassadors in Tel Aviv, urging greater European involvement in Israel and presenting allegations over government policy and Arab representation.

item.title: Confronting the pain: Can you forgive your child?
item.description: Dealing with children who derail your life.

item.title: The Mask of NATO Has Fallen: Turkey is revealed as a mortal threat to Israel and the West
item.description: Turkey under Erdogan is not a democratic bridge between East and West, nor is it a reliable pillar of transatlantic security; it is an expansionist, authoritarian power fundamentally hostile to democratic governance, Western values, and the existence of Israel in the Middle East. Another wake up call. Opinion.

item.title: Reform MK: Arab parties' success is important
item.description: 'Democrats' MK Gilad Kariv says party not competing with Arab parties for voters, insists strong Arab representation important for Israeli democracy.

item.title: Turkey’s expanding maritime ambitions-and the challenge for Israel
item.description: Developments suggest that Turkey is gradually acquiring the ability to project naval power across two strategically important maritime theaters: the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. Israel must plan its next steps. Opinion.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas terrorist who held Israeli hostages
item.description: Hamas commander Sabahi Sami Mahmoud Shahata, who participated in the October 7 massacre and held multiple hostages in captivity, eliminated in IDF strike in Nuseirat.

item.title: The yetse hara conundrum
item.description: The manner in which we confront the wiles of the yetser ha’ra in its efforts to subvert our avodat Hashem, is the true measure of our service of our Creator.

item.title: Suspect named in horrific Beit Shemesh child murder
item.description: Police reveal the identity of 26-year-old man suspected of stabbing two young cousins as they played in a pool, killing seven-year-old Hillel Mordechai Dadon.

item.title: Ancient Jerusalem water system opens to visitors
item.description: Solomon's Pools takes a major step toward opening to the public, offering visitors a rare look at the ancient system that supplied Jerusalem during the Second Temple period.

item.title: 44 years later: Yehuda Katz, who fell in 1982, is laid to rest
item.description: Family, friends and fellow yeshiva students gather to accompany Yehuda Yekutiel Katz to his final resting place, 44 years after he went missing in the Battle of Sultan Yacoub.
